card.name: Words leading into bowel and stool terms
card.fires_on: Small linking words and numbers just before a bowel-related term such as stool, bowel movements or colonic contents, mostly in diarrhea or lactulose dosing text. Also appears in lists of overdose symptoms.

modes.label: Before stool counts
modes.description: A word or number right before stools or bowel movements, as in target counts or per-event dosing.

modes.label: Linking word before bowel terms
modes.description: Words like of or with that lead into bowel or colonic wording.
modes.example: change in frequency or consistency<< of>> bowel movements

modes.description: Commas inside a list of overdose symptoms with cholinergic signs.
